groups.component: WLAN/USB SSH console (OpenSSH, public key only)
groups.health_check: sshd -t && systemctl is-active sshd.service && sshd -T | grep -qx 'passwordauthentication no' && sshd -T | grep -qx 'kbdinteractiveauthentication no' && sshd -T | grep -q '^allowusers nuxel@10.20.30.0/24$'
groups.rollback: restore <target>.nuxel-rollback (or remove a newly-created <target>), then systemctl restart sshd.service; the root authorized_keys and the serial console are never modified

note: Key-only WLAN/USB SSH policy. Every write is staged, hashed, installed atomically and rolled back by nuxel-live-deploy.py. Does not flash, reboot or touch the kernel.
